title: Real-time ad cleanup and safer streaming controls
message: Version 3.7.0 adds an early-running live ad cleanup helper, watches dynamic page changes, and clicks clearly labelled skip-ad controls where available. In-stream/server-inserted ads remain platform-dependent.
features: Early document-start ad cleanup helper on supported video platforms
MutationObserver-based response to dynamically inserted ad elements
Clicks explicit Skip Ad controls where available
Preserves video players and avoids DRM/player manipulation
Existing network-level Declarative Net Request filtering remains active
